title: Battle result
description: Outcome of one tactical engagement, sent back to the strategic layer (control, attribution, events) and to Management (roster, wounds, xp, loot, reputation). Spec: TAC-003, TAC-095, STR-017, STR-023, STR-058, MGT-006, MGT-011, MGT-035, MGT-056..MGT-064.

objectives.description: Final per objective: a mission whose goal is met counts as completed even if the squad is lost afterwards (GEN-002, MGT-044); op success is decided at op level (at least one soldier back at an FOB), not by outcome = wiped

metTurn.description: Turn the objective was met; it stays met (TAC-076)

soldiers.description: Every player soldier who took part

exitId.description: status leftMap: id of the exit used, from the map's exits (tactical_map_request exits[].id or mapgen-tactical exits[].id; TAC-038, TAC-080)

equipment.description: Slot → item instance after the battle (ammo used, durability, condition); same slots as tactical_map_request, holster included

skillUse.description: Skill uses for growth, one entry per skill used (MGT-023; shape spec choice, cleanup 2026-11-24)

uses.description: Gaining uses of that skill in this battle; each gives skillGrowth.xpPerUse xp

deedEvents.description: Optional deeds (MGT-017): rescues, carries under fire, lowest head/thorax HP %

morale.description: The soldier's battle morale at the end (for leftMap: when it left), without the Leadership bonus (TAC-095)

aiUnits.description: Every AI-controlled unit of the tactical map request that is not a player soldier (opponent, third side, neutrals, allied AI units on the player side), so the strategic layer can update its per-soldier records (STR-017, STR-023; TAC-095). Player-only fields (skillUse, kills, deedEvents, equipment, acts) are never given here

faction.description: The unit's side (its sides[] entry's faction)

status.description: At battle end; captured = restrained and carried off the map by the player's side (TAC-073, TAC-074)

exitId.description: status leftMap: id of the exit used (TAC-038)

zoneHp.description: zone → HP at battle end (for leftMap: when it left), same zones as soldiers[].zoneHp (TAC-057)

morale.description: Battle morale at the end (for leftMap: when it left), without the Leadership bonus (TAC-095)

squadMorale.description: Average of soldiers[].morale over the player soldiers still alive (TAC-095)

loot.description: Items carried out (on soldiers or in the vehicle)

leftBehind.description: Gear left on the map or on bodies

casualties.description: Killed and wounded per faction, including AI sides

acts.description: Reputation-relevant acts by the player's side: attack on non-hostile, civilian or prisoner kills, cargo destroyed or stolen, VIP captured or killed (MGT-056..MGT-060). Applied only when witnessed (witnesses, MGT-064)

type.description: The act, named by its management-rules repActs key (MGT-060); the battle-side subset of reputationAct act

faction.description: The faction the act directly affects (MGT-060); absent for warCrime (every faction, MGT-059)

count.description: How many times in this battle (default 1); killSoldier: soldiers of that faction killed, capped by repActs.killCapPerFight (MGT-058)

witnesses.description: faction → surviving witnesses (count); only witnessed acts are attributed (MGT-064)

poiControl.description: Faction holding the point of interest after the battle
